policy.human_version: All Duskcue deliverables share the public SemVer-compatible server release train, for example 0.16.0.
policy.build_metadata: Client build metadata may append platform and CI run identifiers outside store-visible version names.
policy.compatibility_rule: A client release must declare the minimum compatible server API contract version and fail closed when required contract domains are missing.
policy.downgrade_rule: Clients may downgrade only across builds that keep the same local storage schema or run an explicit rollback migration.

targets.version_source: Cargo workspace package version and container image tag
targets.rule: Server image tags use vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and immutable digest pinning for releases.
Web is deployed with the server and must not claim compatibility beyond the bundled server contract.

targets.monotonic_field: platform package build number where supported
targets.rule: Desktop shares the server release train but can publish patch builds for packaging/signing fixes.

targets.version_source: Flutter pubspec version plus Android versionCode
targets.rule: Android versionCode must increase monotonically for every uploaded artifact; versionName remains user-visible SemVer.
Apple CFBundleVersion build string must uniquely identify each uploaded build for a bundle ID and version.

targets.monotonic_field: platform build number or package revision
targets.rule: TV clients must declare supported server contract version and platform surface fixture version.
